summary: Dirt pull-off at the bush edge of a cul-de-sac bend, homes across the road.
reasons: Pin is in thick bush, no track reaches it
Bare dirt verge meets road at bend

drivers.seclusion: Reserve bush behind and a motorway beyond it; the nearest houses stand roughly 25 m away across the road at the bend.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin sits in dense bush with no track or tyre marks, so the pin is off. A bare dirt patch with a sign post meets the road edge at the bend and looks wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential road; heavy motorway noise from the west.
drivers.convention: No vehicles, tents or tracks visible; the dirt patch looks like a trail entry.

flags: Steep: pin area averages about 9.6% grade, up to 22%
Dirt patch may be a walking-trail entry, so a gate or bollard may exist
Pin is in bush, not on the usable place
sun_shade: Open dirt at the road edge; eucalypt canopy to the north and west gives afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the dirt patch is a closed trail head
Slope at the pull-off itself, as the DEM samples centre on the pin

best_section.where: Dirt pull-off on the bush side of the road bend, about 50 m south of the pin
